title: Add a custom parameter to every component
summary: Shows how to create a parameter with the PCB parameters factory and add or update it on every component of a board through IPCB_PrimitiveParameters, inside a modify bracket.
phrasings: set a parameter on all PCB components
add a part number to each footprint on a board
update a component parameter value in the PCB editor
read a component's parameters on a PcbDoc

commands.name: AddParamToComponent
commands.description: Add or update a parameter on every component
